seo.title: Privacy Policy
seo.description: Read the Revotek Elevators Privacy Policy to learn how we collect, use, protect, retain, and disclose personal information when you use our website.

hero.heading: Privacy Policy
hero.description: Learn how Revotek Elevators collects, uses, protects, and handles your information when you visit our website or use our services.

privacyPolicyPageContent.introduction: Welcome to Revotek Elevators. Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, protect, and disclose your information when you visit our website or use our services.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.introduction: We may collect the following information:

groups.heading: Personal Information
items: Any information submitted through our contact or quotation forms

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.introduction: The information we collect may be used to:
items: Schedule inspections, installations, maintenance, or repairs.
Improve our website and customer experience.
Send service updates and important notifications.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: Our website may use cookies to improve browsing experience, remember user preferences, analyze website traffic, and enhance website performance.
You can disable cookies through your browser settings at any time.

sections.title: Data Security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.
Although we strive to use commercially acceptable methods to protect your data, no method of internet transmission is 100% secure.

sections.title: Sharing of Information
paragraphs: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information.
sections.introduction: Information may only be shared with:
items: Technology providers assisting with website operations

sections.title: Third-Party Services
paragraphs: Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of external websites.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.introduction: Depending on applicable laws, you may have the right to:

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal information only as long as necessary to fulfill business, legal, and service requirements.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Our services are intended for businesses and property owners. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18 years of age.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will become effective immediately after being published on this page.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact us through the contact details provided on our website.
